comment_cpu.description: Label for CPU Temperature. Use 'NOTEMP' to hide.

comment_cs.description: Label for Chip Temperature. Use 'NOTEMP' to hide.

comment_mb.description: Label for Motherboard Temperature. Use 'NOTEMP' to hide.

count.description: Number of update intervals to keep in history.

fahren.description: Display temperatures in Fahrenheit if True, else Celsius.

method.description: Hardware access method: V (via), S (sys), I (isa), A (auto).

probe_chip.description: Specific chip to probe (e.g., lm85, it87). Leave empty to auto-detect.

sec.description: Duration of each update interval in seconds.

tick.description: Number of ticks on the vertical axis.

tmax.description: Maximum temperature value for the Y-axis scale (Celsius).

tmin.description: Minimum temperature value for the Y-axis scale (Celsius).

tyan_tiger_mp.description: Enable support for Tyan Tiger MP motherboards.

vmax.description: Maximum voltage value for the Y-axis scale (Volts).

vmin.description: Minimum voltage value for the Y-axis scale (Volts).

wsec.description: Total seconds of the time window displayed.
